name: organization-switcher
title: Organization switcher
description: Lists the organizations the signed-in user belongs to and makes one the session's active organization; "Personal account" clears it. Optionally creates an organization and switches to it. A native select, so it is right on a phone. Behaviour lives in useOrganizationList() of @tula-tech/react; this is presentation you own.
docs: Draw <OrganizationSwitcher onSwitch={() => router.refresh()} allowCreate /> inside <TulaProvider> from @tula-tech/react, for a signed-in user, where the environment has organizations switched on (organizations.enabled). Pass allowCreate only where users may create organizations (organizations.allowUserCreated).
